pictures.scene: Antonello da Messina, Saint Jerome in His Study — the scholar sitting at his desk in the great hall with his books open in front of him, for the choirmaster to the tune of the lilies a maskil of the sons of Korah a love song, my heart is stirred by a noble theme
pictures.name: pd_antonello_da_messina_saint_jerome_in_his_study

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saul and David — the king listening under his turban while the harp is played in front of him, as I recite my verses to the king, my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saul_and_david

pictures.scene: Quentin Metsys, Salvator Mundi — the face of Christ raised with His hand lifted in blessing, you are the most handsome of men, grace has anointed your lips
pictures.name: pd_metsys_salvator_mundi

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint George and the Dragon — the rider driving his lance home over the beast with his cloak flying out behind him, therefore God has blessed you forever, strap your sword at your side O mighty warrior
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_george_and_the_dragon

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, Philip IV on Horseback — the king riding out in his armour with the baton in his hand, appear in your majesty and splendor, in your splendor ride forth in victory
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_philip_iv_on_horseback

pictures.scene: Ambrogio Lorenzetti, Allegory of Good Government — Justice enthroned with her scales while the citizens come up to her in a line below, on behalf of truth and humility and justice, may your right hand show your awesome deeds
pictures.name: pd_lorenzetti_allegory_of_good_government

pictures.scene: Piero della Francesca, Battle between Heraclius and Chosroes — the horsemen pressed together with the lances crossing over their heads and the fallen under the hooves, your arrows pierce the hearts of the king's foes, the nations fall beneath your feet
pictures.name: pd_piero_della_francesca_battle_between_heraclius_and_chosroes

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — the figure seated in red under the triple crown with the sceptre in His hand, your throne O God endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Moses with the Ten Commandments — the lawgiver lifting the two tablets of the law over his head, you have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_moses_with_the_ten_commandments

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Coronation of Charlemagne — the pope setting the crown on the kneeling king while the bishops stand around them, therefore God your God has anointed you, above your companions with the oil of joy
pictures.name: pd_raphael_the_coronation_of_charlemagne

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — the king in his gold brocade holding out the covered vessel of spices, all your garments are fragrant, with myrrh and aloes and cassia
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_adoration_of_the_kings

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, The Concert — the players at the harpsichord and the lute together in the quiet room, from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_the_concert

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, Queen Henrietta Maria — the queen standing in her silk gown with the crown on the table beside her, the daughters of kings are among your honored women, the queen stands at your right hand
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_queen_henrietta_maria

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Annunciation — the girl sitting in the loggia with her hands folded while the word is brought to her, listen O daughter consider and incline your ear, forget your people and your father's house
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_annunciation

pictures.scene: Artemisia Gentileschi, Esther before Ahasuerus — the king leaning forward out of his throne towards the woman who has come in to him, and the king will desire your beauty, bow to him for he is your lord
pictures.name: pd_gentileschi_esther_before_ahasuerus

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, Seaport with the Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba — the trading ships lying in the harbour mouth at sunrise with the boats rowing out to them, the Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift, men of wealth will seek your favor
pictures.name: pd_claude_lorrain_seaport_with_the_embarkation_of_the_queen_of_sheba

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, Infanta Margarita Teresa in a Blue Dress — the princess standing by herself in her chamber in the great blue and silver gown, all glorious is the princess in her chamber, her gown is embroidered with gold
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_infanta_margarita_teresa_in_a_blue_dress

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Holy Virgins — the company of women walking over the grass together with the palms in their hands, in colorful garments she is led to the king, her virgin companions are brought before you
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_holy_virgins

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Wedding at Cana — the wedding feast with the players at their instruments and the guests along the whole table, they are led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king
pictures.name: pd_veronese_the_wedding_at_cana

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Five Eldest Children of Charles I — the king's children standing together in the hall with the great dog beside them, your sons will succeed your fathers, you will make them princes throughout the land
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_the_five_eldest_children_of_charles_i

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — God enthroned above with the companies of every nation gathered round the altar in the meadow below, I will commemorate your name through all generations, therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_mystic_lamb

lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song.
My heart is stirred by a noble theme
as I recite my verses to the king;
my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
You are the most handsome of men;
grace has anointed your lips;
therefore God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior;
appear in your majesty and splendor.
In your splendor ride forth in victory
on behalf of truth and humility and justice;
may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes;
the nations fall beneath your feet.
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever,
and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness
and hated wickedness;
therefore God, your God, has anointed you
above your companions with the oil of joy.
All your garments are fragrant
with myrrh and aloes and cassia;
from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
The daughters of kings are among your honored women;
the queen stands at your right hand,
adorned with the gold of Ophir.
Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear:
Forget your people and your father’s house,
and the king will desire your beauty;
bow to him, for he is your lord.
The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift;
men of wealth will seek your favor.
All glorious is the princess in her chamber;
her gown is embroidered with gold.
In colorful garments she is led to the king;
her virgin companions are brought before you.
They are led in with joy and gladness;
they enter the palace of the king.
Your sons will succeed your fathers;
you will make them princes throughout the land.
I will commemorate your name through all generations;
therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
